items.text: Never have I ever fallen asleep in a meeting
Never have I ever replied all by mistake
Never have I ever pretended to be on a call while I was on the toilet
Never have I ever called in sick when I was perfectly fine
Never have I ever stayed late to finish a task nobody noticed
Never have I ever been praised for something a colleague did
Never have I ever sent an email with a typo in the subject line
Never have I ever been fired from a job
Never have I ever failed a job interview badly
Never have I ever nodded along to an acronym I did not understand
Never have I ever worked from a cafe for a whole week
Never have I ever forgotten a colleague's name to their face
Never have I ever kept my camera off for an entire video call
Never have I ever quit a job after one week
Never have I ever worked a night shift
Never have I ever used a spreadsheet to plan a party
Never have I ever asked for a pay rise and got it
Never have I ever worked in a family business
Never have I ever brought a plant to the office
Never have I ever taken a work call on holiday
Never have I ever hidden in the toilets to avoid someone
Never have I ever eaten lunch at my desk every day for a month
Never have I ever been promoted
Never have I ever been yelled at by a boss
Never have I ever spilled coffee on a laptop
Never have I ever worked for a company with a mascot
Never have I ever left a meeting early by pretending I had another call
Never have I ever copied the wrong person on a sensitive email
Never have I ever ordered a team lunch for everyone
Never have I ever printed something personal at the office
Never have I ever been on a team building retreat
Never have I ever fixed the office printer myself
Never have I ever worked in a restaurant
Never have I ever answered a work email while on holiday
Never have I ever given a presentation without slides
Never have I ever started a new job on a Monday and cried at lunch
Never have I ever stayed in a job I hated for over a year
Never have I ever become someone's boss
Never have I ever left an anonymous sticky note on someone's desk
Never have I ever handed in a project at the very last minute
Never have I ever been a freelancer
Never have I ever gone on a work trip abroad
Never have I ever forgotten I was on camera during a video call
Never have I ever done a job interview in my pyjamas
Never have I ever been sent home early from work
